So maybe formula should include Cl, but they gave C11H15O2S (maybe they omitted Cl). If we include Cl, DBE would be 4, but they said 5. Something inconsistent.

So three methyls on ring, plus one methyl on S (makes 4 methyl groups total, but they said 3 methyl groups present. So conflict.
